rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday equivalent when something is not typical or usual.

example.english: This cold weather today is really uncharacteristic.
example.traditional: 今日天氣咁凍，真係唔尋常。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 gam3 dung3 zan1 hai6 m4 cam4 soeng4

rows.note: Use this specifically when a person's or thing's behavior does not fit its usual pattern.

example.english: Leaving work so early today is uncharacteristic of him.
example.traditional: 佢今日咁早收工，真係唔似平時。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 gam3 zou2 sau1 gung1 zan1 hai6 m4 ci5 ping4 si4
